Lesson 8 only taught cell type, number of cells, cell wall, chlorophyll and mode of nutrition. The exemplar's Amoeba entry uses 'feeds by taking in food' and omits the cell wall and chlorophyll evidence, so the prompt's required evidence set is inconsistently applied. The exemplar also gives no cell wall or chlorophyll evidence for E. coli.
